india.one_line: India joins supply chain protection efforts as SEBI prepares AI market guidelines and deeptech startups secure funding.

themes.title: India joins AI supply chain accord
themes.text: India, the US, Japan, and the UK agreed to create a joint list of AI technologies and supply chains to protect from China.

stories.headline: US and allies agree to create joint list to protect AI supply chains from China

themes.title: SEBI to regulate AI in markets
themes.text: SEBI will soon issue guidelines requiring market firms to disclose AI usage and maintain human oversight over critical decisions.

stories.headline: SEBI to issue guidelines for AI use and human oversight in capital markets

themes.title: Indian deeptech startups secure funding
themes.text: Bharat Semi raised $24 million for AI sensors, and Oister Global launched a ₹600 crore deeptech fund for Indian startups.

stories.headline: Indian chip startup Bharat Semi lands $24M seed round for AI sensors
Oister Global launches ₹600 Cr growth-stage deeptech fund
